# shadcn stylesheet provenance

`tailwind.css` and `LICENSE.md` are copied unchanged from the official npm package `shadcn@4.18.0`, tarball SHA-1 `79cd8dafc26310575dd78850393da827a6eafb22`. The MIT notice is retained alongside the stylesheet. No generator executable or transitive toolchain is vendored.

The application originally imported `shadcn/tailwind.css`, so the complete stylesheet remains part of the build. The global CSS import now points to this reviewed local copy. The component generator is not an application runtime requirement. To generate new components in future, review and run an explicitly selected official generator version separately; it is not installed automatically by this app.

Official source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui
